The '''Shirshir Desert''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nishr]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was the location of the [[Nishr Taskforce]]'s [[Nishr Base Three|Base Three]].
